_comment: Metadata for the feature demo gallery. id matches the test title in demos.spec.ts (and the raw/demos-<id>-chromium/ folder). build-gallery.mjs converts each recorded video to a small animated WebP and renders feature-demos.html.

demos.title: Navigate tuples
demos.description: Move between image tuples; the carousel highlight and main image follow.

demos.title: Switch modality
demos.description: Flip between modalities (e.g. GT vs PRED) for the current tuple; the active pill updates.

demos.title: Zoom
demos.description: Scroll to zoom into the image; press Esc to reset to fit.

demos.title: Pan
demos.description: When zoomed in, drag to move around the image.

demos.title: Crop
demos.description: Enter crop mode, draw a rectangle, and confirm to crop all modalities at once.

demos.title: Vote a winner
demos.description: Mark the current modality as the winner for this tuple; saved to results.txt.

demos.title: Reorder modalities
demos.description: Reorder the modality pills to change comparison order (and PPTX export order).

demos.title: Keyboard help
demos.description: Open the keyboard-shortcut reference; Esc closes it.

demos.title: Collapse tools panel
demos.description: Collapse or expand the floating Tools/navigator panel.

demos.title: Click a modality pill
demos.description: Click a colored modality pill to jump straight to that modality.
